annotation.title_clean: Projeto de Lei nº 1797/2024 - Estabelece normas gerais para o desenvolvimento, implementação e uso responsável de sistemas de Inteligência Artificial
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 1797/2024 - Establishes general rules for the responsible development, implementation and use of Artificial Intelligence systems
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Câmara dos Deputados (Dep. Dr. Allan Garcês)
named_instruments_referenced: Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD, Lei 13.709/2018)
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian Chamber of Deputies bill introduced May 2024 setting general rules for responsible AI to protect human rights. It bans discriminatory AI, biometric categorisation and subliminal manipulation, imposes strict liability on providers, grants rights to contest decisions, empowers the ANPD to classify risks, and creates a National AI Council.
key_provisions_or_claims: Principles: human rights, human participation, traceability, auditability, AI-content labelling
Prohibits discriminatory AI, biometric categorisation and subliminal or manipulative techniques
Strict liability of AI providers/operators for property or moral damage regardless of autonomy
Right to contest and review significant AI decisions
ANPD to regulate, sanction and classify AI risk levels; creates interministerial National AI Council (CNIA)
